Before you write to us

Most questions we receive are already answered somewhere on the site. These three pages solve the majority of them, and they are available instantly:

Frequently asked questions

Pricing, expiry, error correction levels, export formats and why a code will not scan.

Step-by-step guides

WiFi, vCard, restaurant menu and event QR codes, plus printing and sizing advice.

Privacy questions

What stays on your device, what we never see, and how to clear your local history.

Reporting a security issue

If you believe you have found a vulnerability that could expose another person's data, please email contact@toolbox168.xyz with the subject line "Security" before disclosing it publicly. Because QR Tool Studio performs every operation locally in your browser, the attack surface is limited to the static assets we serve — but we take reports seriously and will respond within one business day.

QR Tool Studio
Herramienta online gratuita · 8 tipos

QR Tool Studio es un generador de códigos QR en línea gratuito, ligero y profesional. Compatible con 8 tipos: URL, vCard, WiFi, texto, correo electrónico, teléfono, SMS y ubicación. Personalice colores degradados, logotipo central, 6 estilos de matriz. Exportación con un clic a PNG / SVG / JPEG, generación por lotes en ZIP.
